scenarios.name: Decline removal of duplicate model-state member names

scenario_steps.name: The MCAD Software has a model-state table with members Capture State and Model State1
the user changes the Model State1 member cell to "Capture State" and presses Enter
both matching member-name cells are highlighted yellow
a warning identifies the duplicate name and says duplicates will be removed if the user continues
the warning offers Yes and No
the table remains open with both duplicate names highlighted
the table closes without accepting the rename
